workstreams.name: Engine and multi-objective optimization
workstreams.mission: Generate and compare materially different feasible plans instead of selecting only from a small fixed heuristic portfolio.

workstreams.name: Store Scan, CAD and spatial truth
workstreams.mission: Convert measured camera, LiDAR, AR depth and CAD evidence into reviewable Store DNA without silently inventing geometry or operational semantics.

workstreams.name: 2D CAD and high-fidelity 3D Digital Twin
workstreams.mission: Make the generated result visually and dimensionally useful for real store design, installation and review rather than a debug visualization.

workstreams.name: Picker, congestion and replenishment simulation
workstreams.mission: Score plans against observed order baskets, route distance, congestion, replenishment and operational flow.

workstreams.name: Shelf Scan and compliance vision
workstreams.mission: Compare field shelf evidence with the approved plan and explain SKU, facing, gap and placement differences.

workstreams.name: SKU, fixture and Store DNA authority
workstreams.mission: Prevent optimization or rendering from manufacturing missing dimensions, fixture capacity, images or measured store facts.

workstreams.name: Blind benchmark and adversarial product critique
workstreams.mission: Judge the generated output against expert manual layouts and market baselines instead of repository activity.

definition_of_done: Market leadership may be claimed only after real-store scans, measured Store DNA, real assets, blind expert comparison, field KPI evidence and external market baseline evidence all pass. CI or synthetic fixtures alone are never sufficient.
